files.context.md: Synthetic human cultured-cell marker panel. Rows are fictional markers; columns are sample_id. Values are background-corrected and normalized log2 intensity. Missing values would be NA; zero is a value on the log2 scale. Each donor is split into control and treated aliquots at 24 hours. Donors are independent; observations from the same donor are paired. There are no technical repeats or measurement failures. Batch is constant within each donor. The comparison of interest is treated minus control. No external feature annotation is required. No real biological claims should be made from these synthetic data.
